basque.definition:
n. a member of a people of unknown origin living in the western Pyrenees in France and Spain
n. the language of the Basque people; of no known relation to any other language
basque.translation:
n. 巴斯克衫(女子紧身上衣), 巴斯克人, 巴斯克语
a. 巴斯克人的

basque fatherland and liberty.translation: [网络] 西班牙；巴斯克民族和自由组织；自由祖国巴斯克

basque homeland and freedom.translation: [网络] 巴斯克国土与自由

basques.definition:
